description: This file defines an abstract class 'TableWithData' that extends 'Table' and manages a collection of 'DataCell' objects, providing functionality for data manipulation, interpolation, display, and file operations within a GUI application related to ECU mapping or table editing.

classes.name: TableWithData
classes.description: An abstract class managing tabular data with UI interactions, interpolation, data persistence, and editing capabilities in a GUI context.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Assigns an array of DataCell objects to the table.

methods.name: getDataCell
methods.description: Retrieves a DataCell at the specified index.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Interpolates data between selected points horizontally.

methods.name: selectCellAt
methods.description: Selects and highlights the cell at the given index.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the GUI dimensions based on data and layout parameters.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments values of selected cells if the user has adequate permissions.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies values of selected cells if permitted.

methods.name: addKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a KeyListener to the table and its cells.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Triggers each DataCell to draw itself.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves current data to a binary array, considering user permissions and data type.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates DataCells from a byte array, interpreting data as float or integer.
